description: Header file defining classes and functions for Metal shader library management and GPU tensor address retrieval in the ATen native MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) backend.

classes.name: MetalKernelFunction
classes.description: Represents a Metal compute kernel function, managing pipeline state, arguments, and dispatching.

classes.name: MetalShaderLibrary
classes.description: Manages Metal shader source code, compilation, and retrieval of kernel functions.

classes.name: DynamicMetalShaderLibrary
classes.description: A derived class that compiles the Metal shader library upon instantiation for dynamic use.

methods.name: getKernelFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a shared pointer to a MetalKernelFunction by name.

methods.name: exec_unary_kernel
methods.description: Executes a unary kernel with the given tensor iterator and kernel name.

methods.name: exec_binary_kernel
methods.description: Executes a binary kernel with the given tensor iterator and kernel name.

methods.name: exec_ternary_kernel
methods.description: Executes a ternary kernel with the given tensor iterator and kernel name.
